title: Young symmetrizers of S_3 as symmetry-adapted tensor projectors
expression_sketch: Group algebra of S_3 on three tensor factors. Elements written as one-line images of 123: e_123=id, e_213=(1 2), e_321=(1 3), e_132=(2 3), e_231=(1 2 3), e_312=(1 3 2).  Young symmetrizer of the standard (2,1)-tableau (Wikipedia): c_(2,1) = e_123 + e_213 - e_321 - e_312.  Idempotent relation: c_(2,1)**2 = 3*c_(2,1), so the primitive projector is e_(2,1) = c_(2,1)/3.  Full symmetrizer / trivial isotypic projector: P_(3) = (1/6)*Sum_{g in S_3} g = (1/6)*(e_123+e_213+e_321+e_132+e_231+e_312).  Sign / alternating projector: P_(1^3) = (1/6)*Sum_g sgn(g)*g = (1/6)*(e_123 - e_213 - e_321 - e_132 + e_231 + e_312).  Isotypic projector onto the 2-dimensional mixed representation: P_(2,1)_iso = id - P_(3) - P_(1^3).  These three are orthogonal idempotents summing to id.  On V^{⊗3} they are the GL(V) Young projectors onto Sym^3, ∧^3, and the hook (2,1) module.
latent_structure: Young projectors / Specht modules for S_3: symmetry-adapted decomposition of V^{⊗3} (and of the group algebra) into irreps (3), (1^3), (2,1). Coefficients are the signed row/column symmetrizers, not a dummy relabeling of one tensor.

function_domains.e_g: Group-algebra basis vectors of C[S_3] (or Q[S_3]).
function_domains.c_lambda: Young symmetrizer a_lambda b_lambda of a tableau.

nonzero_conditions.statement: The scalars 3 and 6 are invertible in the coefficient field (char 0, or char not 2 or 3).
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Wikipedia Young symmetrizer: representations defined over Q; alpha_lambda = n!/dim V_lambda

Bruce Sagan, The Symmetric Group, Springer 2001.
Cvitanovic, Group Theory, hep-th/0307186 (Young projection operators, idempotency/orthogonality/completeness).

derived_conditions.statement: alpha_(2,1) = 3! / dim S^{(2,1)} = 6/2 = 3, hence c**2 = 3 c and e=c/3 is idempotent.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

derived_conditions.statement: P_(3) and P_(1^3) are the images of the trivial and sign characters, hence central orthogonal idempotents.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: character projectors (1/|G|) Sum chi(g^{-1}) g with |S_3|=6

derived_conditions.statement: dim of the (2,1) isotypic component in C[S_3] is 2^2=4, matching two primitive tableaux; P_(2,1)_iso is the complementary central idempotent.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED

public_source: Wikipedia Young symmetrizer S_3 example; Fulton-Harris Thm 4.3
why_not_cse_lgg: A generic 3-index tensor expanded into 6 permutations looks like an orbit sum. CSE may factor a coefficient 1 but will not find the signed Young combination that squares to a multiple of itself, nor the split into three irreps. Equal-weight orbit-sum is the tempting wrong structure (see rejected sibling ac-t-rej-index-rename).
proposer_leak_risk: Hide Young, Specht, tableau, hook, isotypic, symmetrizer. Show the six permuted tensors with numerical coefficients only.
notes: Algebra over Q. The Wikipedia one-line labels e_123 etc. are used exactly. Do not silently change a_lambda b_lambda versus b_lambda a_lambda order; the cited c_(2,1) is the Wikipedia product for that tableau.
